set.stimulus:
A certain number of persons sit in a straight row facing north. Farida, Ishaan, Jyoti, Meera, Omkar, Tejas and Yamini are among them; the others are not named. They are not necessarily seated in the same order.

1. Only six persons sit between Yamini and Jyoti.

3. Tejas sits sixth from the left end of the row.
4. Only eight persons sit to the right of Yamini.
5. Farida sits fourth to the right of Omkar.
6. Only four persons sit between Tejas and Meera when counted from the left of Tejas.
7. Only one person sits between Meera and Yamini.
8. Neither Yamini nor Omkar is an immediate neighbour of Tejas.

Clue 5 then places Farida.

Third to the right of Meera: Ishaan → Yamini → Omkar — answer **Omkar**.
